recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Further work is only needed if FHIR-I later reopens the broader semantics of _summary for nested resources or document-specific Bundle summary behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-35852 asked whether Bundle's all-summary designation made _summary inadequate for document Bundle use and requested clarification of how _summary should apply to nested resources such as Bundle.entry.resource. FHIR-I resolved the Published issue as Not Persuasive with Modification: keep Bundle summary flags and add an STU statement that Resource-valued summary elements are expected to convey the nested resource in summary form.
initial_application: Commit 3ce7fc3906 added the requested STU note to source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml. Commit 30c5d5f934 line-wrapped the note and added adjacent rationale from the same Bundle summary area, and 23a31a590b normalized the STU-note macro. The current source retains the applied guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-04-25 recorded the options and the action to create a Zulip discussion; the #conformance Zulip thread discussed contained/nested resources, Parameters.parameter.resource, and Bundle.entry.resource; the 2022-05-02 minutes record the final 12-0-0 Not Persuasive with Modification motion. The active source/fhir.ini Bundle entry keeps source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml in current build scope. Searches found no later FHIR-core decision superseding the seed outcome.
